questions.stem: What are distinct prime factors of the number 26381 ?
Which one of the following is a factor of the polynomial \((x-1)(x-2)(x-4)-90\) ?
What is the square root of \(23-4\sqrt{15}\) ?
What is the remainder after dividing the number \(37^{1000}\) by 9 ?
The sum of LCM and HCF of two numbers is 536 and the difference between LCM and HCF is 296. If one of the numbers is 104, then what is the other number ?
20 men are supposed to complete a work in 10 days. After working for 5 days, they realise that only one-fourth of the work is done. How many more men they need to employ to finish the work on time ?

If \(x\) is a negative real number, then which of the following are not correct ?
1. There is some natural number \(k\) such that \(kx>0\)
2. \(x^2+x>0\) always
3. \(2x<x<-x\)
4. \(x^2\) is always a rational number
Select the correct answer using the code given below :
What is the sum of the linear factors (in \(x\) and \(y\)) of the expression \(2x^2+xy-3y^2\) ?
Which one of the following equations does not have real roots ?
The sum and the product of the roots of a quadratic equation are 7 and 12 respectively. If the bigger root is halved and the smaller root is doubled, then what is the resulting quadratic equation ?

questions.stem: For which values of \(k\), does the equation \(x^2-kx+2=0\) have real and distinct solutions ?
If \(\alpha+\beta+\gamma=\alpha\beta+\beta\gamma+\gamma\alpha\), then what is \((1-\alpha)(1-\beta)(1-\gamma)\) equal to ?
If \(\log_{10}x+\log_{10}x^2=2\log_{10}x+1\), then what is the value of \(x\) ?
The LCM of two prime numbers \(p\) and \(q\) is 2231, where \(p>q\). What is the value of \(p-q\) ?
Three runners are running in a circular track, and they complete one round in 20, 30 and 35 minutes respectively. When will they next meet at the starting point ?
5 pencils, 6 notebooks and 7 erasers cost Rs. 250; whereas 6 pencils, 4 notebooks and 2 erasers cost Rs. 180. What is the cost of 2 notebooks and 4 erasers ?
How many zeros are there in the product \(1^{50}\times 2^{49}\times 3^{48}\times \ldots \times 50^{1}\) ?
If \(p\) and \(q\) \((p>q)\) are the roots of the equation \(x^2-60x+899=0\), then which one of the following is correct ?

questions.stem: If the roots of the equation \(x^2-4x-\log_{10}N=0\) are real, then what is the minimum value of \(N\) ?
If \(5^{x-1}=(2.5)^{\log_{10}5}\), then what is the value of \(x\) ?
If \(96-64a^3+\dfrac{8}{a^6}-\dfrac{48}{a^3}-t^3=0\), then what is \(a^2t+4a^3\) equal to ?
If \(A+B=\dfrac{x^2-8}{x+2}\) and \(A-B=\dfrac{-x^2+2x+4}{x+2}\), then what is \(B\) equal to ?
If \((2ab-b^2):(6a^2-ab)=1:6\), then what is \((a+b):(a-b)\) equal to ?
If \(\dfrac{x}{b+c-a}=\dfrac{y}{b-c-a}=\dfrac{z}{a+b-c}=k\), then what is \(x^2+y^2+z^2-2xy-2yz+2zx\) equal to ?
flags: Middle denominator is printed as 'b - c - a' (verified at 3.5x zoom). The symmetric pattern of the other two denominators (b+c-a and a+b-c) suggests the intended third is 'c+a-b'; transcribed exactly as printed, not repaired.

questions.stem: If three positive numbers are in the ratio \(2:3:5\) and the sum of their squares is 1368, then what is sum of the numbers ?

Consider the following inequalities :
1. \(\dfrac{a^2-b^2}{a^2+b^2}>\dfrac{a-b}{a+b}\) where \(a>b>0\)
2. \(\dfrac{a^3+b^3}{a^2+b^2}>\dfrac{a^2+b^2}{a+b}\) only when \(a>b>0\)
Which of the above is/are correct ?
flags: Subtopic is a loose fit: this is an algebraic-expression inequality, not a linear one. Closest available under 'Inequalities'.

questions.stem: Let work done by \((3n-1)\) men in \((2n+1)\) days be \(x\) and work done by \((3n+1)\) men in \((4n-3)\) days be \(y\). If \(x:y=6:11\), then what is the value of \(n\) ?

If \(\dfrac{ay-bx}{c}=\dfrac{cx-az}{b}=\dfrac{bz-cy}{a}\), then which of the following is/are correct ?
1. \(\dfrac{x}{a}=\dfrac{y}{b}\)
2. \(\dfrac{x+y+z}{a+b+c}=\dfrac{z}{c}\)
Select the correct answer using the code given below :
A person wishes to fence \(375\,\text{m}^2\) rectangular garden. He has 65 m of barbed wire and is able to fence only three sides of the garden. What is the perimeter of the garden ?
If one of the roots of the equation \(ax^2-4ax+15=0\) is \(\frac{3}{2}\), then what is the sum of the squares of the roots ?

questions.stem: A two-digit number is such that the product of the digits is 8. If 63 is added to this number, the digits interchange their places. What is the sum of the digits in the number ?
A motor boat has speed 30 km/hr in still water. It goes 60 km down stream and comes back in \(\frac{9}{2}\) hours. What is the speed of the stream ?

The present age of a father is equal to sum of the ages of his 4 children. After ten years the sum of the ages of the children will be 1.6 times the age of their father. What is the present age of father ?

The sum of numerator and denominator of a fraction is 10. If the numerator is increased by 3 and denominator is decreased by 1, the fraction becomes 1. What is the difference between numerator and denominator of the fraction ?
If the system of equations \(7x+ky=27\) and \(kx+7y=19\) have unique solution, then which one of the following is correct ?
flags: Stem prints 'have unique solution' (subject-verb agreement); transcribed as printed.

questions.stem: A sum of money compounded annually doubles itself in 5 years. In how many years will it become four times of itself ?
Between 3 and 4 O'clock, both hour hand and minute hand will coincide past 3 O'clock between
Sheela can stitch a suit in 2 days, while Meena can stitch a suit in \(1\frac{1}{2}\) days. How many days will both take in stitching 30 suits ?
If \(2x-3y-7=0\), then what is the value of \(8x^3-36x^2y+54xy^2-27y^3-340\) ?
If \(p\) varies directly as \(q\) and inversely as square of \(r\), what is the percentage increase in \(p\) due to an increase in \(q\) by 20% and a decrease in \(r\) by 20% ?

A person agrees to work for 30 days, on a condition that for every day's work he should receive Rs. 500, and that for every day's absence from work he should forfeit Rs. 100. At the end of the time he received Rs. 11,400. How many days did he work ?
A person bought a chair and a table for Rs. 750. He sold the chair at a gain of 5% and the table at a gain of 20%. He gained 16% on the whole. What is original cost of table ?

A person rode one-third of a journey at 60 km/hr, one-third at 50 km/hr and the rest at 40 km/hr. Had the person ridden half of the journey at 60 km/hr and the rest at 40 km/hr, he would have taken 4 minutes longer to complete the journey. What distance did the person ride ?
A person saves Rs. 1000 more than he did the previous year. If he saves Rs. 2000 in the first year, in how many years will he save Rs. 170000 ?
What is the minimum value of \(\cos^3\theta+\sec^3\theta\) where \(0^\circ\le\theta<90^\circ\) ?
questions.subtopic: Maximum and Minimum of Trigonometric Expressions

questions.stem: If \(14\sin^2\theta+10\cos^2\theta=11\) where \(0^\circ<\theta<90^\circ\), then what is the value of \(\tan\theta+\cot\theta\) ?
What is \(\dfrac{\sin^3\theta+\cos^3\theta}{\sin\theta+\cos\theta}+\dfrac{\sin^3\theta-\cos^3\theta}{\sin\theta-\cos\theta}\) equal to ?
A ladder 10 m long reaches a point 10 m below the top of a vertical flagstaff. From foot of the ladder, the elevation of top of the flagstaff is \(60^\circ\). What is the height of flagstaff ?
What is the maximum value of \(1+2\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta-\sin^4\theta-\cos^4\theta\) where \(0^\circ<\theta<90^\circ\) ?
questions.subtopic: Maximum and Minimum of Trigonometric Expressions

questions.stem: From an aeroplane flying above a river at an altitude of 1200 m, it is observed that the angles of depression of opposite points on the two banks of a river are \(30^\circ\) and \(\theta\). If the width of the river is 3000 m, then which one of the following is correct ?
If \(\dfrac{\cos^2\theta-3\cos\theta+2}{\sin^2\theta}=1\), where \(0^\circ<\theta<90^\circ\) then what is \(\sin^2\theta+\cos\theta\) equal to ?

Consider the following :
1. \(\sin^4\theta-\sin^2\theta=\cos^4\theta-\cos^2\theta\)
2. \(\sin^4\theta+\cos^4\theta=1+2\sin^2\theta\cos^2\theta\)
3. \(\tan^4\theta+\tan^2\theta=\sec^4\theta-\sec^2\theta\)
Which of the above are identities ?
flags: Statement 2 is printed with a PLUS sign on the right-hand side ('= 1 + 2 sin^2 theta cos^2 theta'), verified at 3x zoom. Transcribed exactly as printed and not repaired.

questions.stem: What is the value of \(\sin 24^\circ\sin 66^\circ-\cos 24^\circ\cos 66^\circ+\tan 24^\circ\tan 66^\circ-\cot 24^\circ\cot 66^\circ\) ?
If \(x=p\sin A\cos B\), \(y=p\sin A\sin B\) and \(z=p\cos A\), then what is the value of \(x^2+y^2+z^2\) ?
If \(x=m\sec A+n\tan A\) and \(y=m\tan A+n\sec A\), then what is \(x^2-y^2\) equal to ?
If for some \(\theta\) lying between \(0^\circ\) and \(90^\circ\), \(\tan\theta=1\), then what is the value of \(\sin^2\theta-2\sin\theta\cos\theta\) ?
